note: FNS 1064 has two components: (1) the substantive policy rule that status reporting households must only report earned income changes involving source, hourly rate/salary, or employment status (part-time/full-time), and (2) a 5-step QC variance determination procedure for reviewing earned income in these cases. The OLG adequately covers component (1). The Simplified Reporting Examples page (Q1/A1) explicitly states that Simplified Reporting households must report 'any change in earned income (i.e. change in pay per hour, salary amount, starting, stopping or changing full-time or part-time status)' — which maps directly to the FNS triggers of source, hourly rate/salary, and employment status. The Change Reporting Overview page also covers income-related reporting requirements ($125+ threshold). The Interim Report pages provide detailed BEACON procedures for processing earned income changes at IR. Component (2) — the 5-step QC variance determination procedure — is purely QC methodology (how reviewers compare verified income to EW amounts, apply corrections, and determine excludable changes). This is not caseworker policy and has no OLG equivalent, which is expected.
